caption: The drawing features a single, centrally placed circular object with intricate geometric patterns. The object is brown in color, with darker shading to create depth and texture. The outer edge of the circle is decorated with a zigzag or sawtooth border. Inside this border, there are several concentric rings. Within the innermost area, there is a six-petaled flower design, with each petal radiating from the center. Overlapping bands, decorated with alternating diagonal lines, form a star-like pattern that intersects around the central flower. The overall composition is symmetrical and rendered in a way that emphasizes the carved, three-dimensional appearance of the object. Below the object, centered and in small text, the words “A. L. DAVISON II” appear. The background is plain and off-white, with no other elements present.
title: Iron Stand
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
